relationships.subject: TNF-α
relationships.evidence_quote: an in vitro study using primary cultured TG neurons demonstrated that TNFα upregulated the trafficking of TRPV1 and TRPA1 to the surface of sensory neurons

relationships.subject: PKA
relationships.evidence_quote: PKA was reported to transiently sensitize capsaicin-activated currents in rat sensory neurons and potentiate heat-activated currents in HEK 293T cells that heterologously express TRPV1

relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: PGE2 released by tumor cells contributes to nociceptor sensitization by binding to the Gs-protein-coupled receptor subtypes EP3C and EP4

relationships.subject: bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: The action of BK is mediated through the activation of B1 receptors, which are typically expressed at low but detectable levels in sensory neurons, and B2 membrane receptors

key_findings: Review: tumor-microenvironment mediators (TNF-α, NGF, BK, PGE2, protons) sensitize TRPV1/TRPA1 via PLC, PI3K, PKC and PKA.
Plant secondary metabolites may modulate TRP channels to relieve cancer pain.
